pages.text: A breach is a bubble of different vacuum (Coleman-De Luccia). A wall of tension σ around a region whose energy is lower by Δε has critical radius R = 3σ/Δε, and the nucleation rate goes as exp(−B), B = 27π²σ⁴/(2Δε³). Too fast, and the bubble swallows everything.
$(thing)Set$(): Wall tension σ, Energy difference Δε, Barrier field.$(br2)$(thing)Disturbance$(): Vacuum energy noise: Δε·(1 ± 0.2%·d).

$(thing)Limits$(): Bubbles everywhere: the breach spreads beyond the chamber; Barrier not shaped: the wall cannot form; Interlock: barrier-shaping coils not superconducting (too warm); Field above the critical field: the barrier-shaping coils quench.$(br2)$(thing)Rate$(): The breach runs at a fixed pace.
$(thing)Equations$()$(br)Critical radius: R_c = 3σ/Δε$(br)Bounce action B: B = 27π²σ⁴/(2Δε³)$(br)Bubbles per second: N = Δε·e^(−B)·V·t$(br)Critical field: B_c(T) = B_c2(0)·(1 − (T/T_c)²)
